nodes.description: Current contract owner address inherited from Owned; compared against msg.sender in onlyOwner and used as rescue recipient.
Pending owner address stored by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol, set to 'ILO' in the constructor.
Token name, set to 'IslandLoft' in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, 350000000e18, returned by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; written by transfer and transferFrom.
Mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance table; written by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Pure SafeMath addition: c = a + b with require(c >= a).
Pure SafeMath subtraction: require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
Pure SafeMath multiplication with overflow require.
Pure SafeMath division with require(b > 0).
onlyOwner function that stages _newOwner into newOwner.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and moves owner.
Owned constructor hard-coding the deployer owner address 0xE6Db2C82f475436EEa6EfdBB79961411F21597eD.
IslandLoft constructor setting name/symbol/decimals, total supply and minting the full supply to owner.
View returning _totalSupply.
View returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public transfer debiting msg.sender via safeSub and crediting 'to' via safeAdd.
Virtual approve writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no double-spend check.
Virtual transferFrom debiting 'from' balance and allowed[from][msg.sender], crediting 'to'.
View returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then invokes ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with the caller, tokens and data.
Payable receive function that always reverts, refusing plain ETH.
onlyOwner rescue that calls IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
Abstract callback declared by ApproveAndCallFallBack, implemented by the spender contract.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and as balance/allowance index.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, address(this), data) after allowance state update.
External call IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary attacker-supplied token address.
Arithmetic debit balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) executed before the corresponding credit.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes balances as the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is debited in transferFrom.
Caller-controlled msg.sender seeds both the allowance update and the subsequent external call context in approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner in transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier guards the transferAnyERC20Token rescue call.
msg.sender is directly compared with the owner state variable for authorization.
owner state variable gates execution of transferOwnership via the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner state variable gates execution of acceptOwnership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] through safeSub.
transfer credits balances[to] through safeAdd.
transfer writes the balances mapping.
balance debit arithmetic happens before the credit and before the Transfer event.
transferFrom uses safeSub on balances[from] and on the allowance.
transferFrom uses safeAdd on balances[to].
transferFrom writes the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval call after updating allowance state.
Execution flow of approveAndCall continues into the spender's receiveApproval implementation.
External call invokes receiveApproval on an arbitrary attacker-supplied spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
External token transfer executes only after the onlyOwner authorization check.
Owner address is the fixed recipient of the rescued tokens.
